modern: Why do unskilled and ignorant souls disturb the one who has skill and knowledge? What soul, then, has skill and knowledge? The one which knows beginning and end, and knows the reason which pervades all substance and which, through all time, by fixed periods or revolutions, governs the universe.
original: Why do unskilled and ignorant souls disturb him who has skill and knowledge? What soul then has skill and knowledge? That which knows beginning and end, and knows the reason which pervades all substance, and though all time by fixed periods [revolutions] administers the universe.
